user.title: Move Sensor BLE OTA
user.description: BLE OTA for the motion sensor via Bluetooth proxies. Leave the key empty to read move_sensor_ble_ota_key from /config/esphome/secrets.yaml.

upload.title: Upload firmware
upload.description: Pick a .bin built by ESPHome (OTA format or factory). It is checked, saved to the firmware folder and — if enabled — flashed at the next sensor wake (PIR or telemetry).

abort.firmware_uploaded: Uploaded {file}: project {project}, version {version}, {size} KB{factory}. Flashing started: {started}. Progress: «OTA status» / «OTA progress» on the device page.
abort.not_loaded: Integration is not loaded — restart Home Assistant.
